summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as keyword rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ (ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py, ServiceFargate.py), with three test modules in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. Running the ECS test directory with PYTHONPATH=src under the reference venv gives 73 passed. The venv imports an installed cfnlint otherwise, and ruff/black are not installed there, so formatting was checked by hand for the 88-column limit only. Nothing is committed. Choices made: one E3052 error per service/task-definition pair; a task definition is treated as awsvpc if any Fn::If branch says so; booleans are skipped in E3053; the E3053 shortdesc was shortened to fit 88 columns. The E3052 unsatisfiable-condition test uses A AND NOT A, because the conditions engine does not treat a literal Fn::Equals as a contradiction.
